column1: # One verdict per published field of the four resources whose fields
# decide what this server can do, and of every schema they reach by $ref. `gates api-fields` holds this,
# testdata/api-surface.json and internal/gcal to each other, and runs in
# `modeled` names a field internal/gcal carries; the gate fails if the
# struct does not have it. `out` says why this server ignores it; the
# gate fails if the struct DOES have it, so the record cannot claim a
# field is ignored while the code reads it.
# Methods are the coarse axis (testdata/api-coverage.tsv). This is the
# fine one, and it exists because this API keeps its capability in the
